note: Keys the team install may need. The installer prompts (masked) when interactive, allows skipping, and prints a unified configuration summary at the end. Values are never echoed; they are stored 0600 in ~/.openclaw/team/.secrets.env (not in the repo).

MODEL_API_KEY.purpose: Model provider key (the team's LLM). Your provider's key.
MODEL_API_KEY.configure: export MODEL_API_KEY=…  &&  openclaw config set models.providers.<provider>.apiKey --ref-provider default --ref-source env --ref-id MODEL_API_KEY

MEMORY_SEARCH_API_KEY.configure: export MEMORY_SEARCH_API_KEY=…  &&  openclaw config set memory.search.remote.apiKey --ref-provider default --ref-source env --ref-id MEMORY_SEARCH_API_KEY

TAVILY_API_KEY.purpose: Tavily web search/extract key — used by the tavily-* skills (tavily-cli/tavily-search/tavily-extract/tavily-map/tavily-crawl/tavily-research/tavily-dynamic-search). Keyless access has limits.
TAVILY_API_KEY.configure: export TAVILY_API_KEY=…  in the Gateway environment (consumed by the `tvly` CLI used by the tavily-* skills)

FIGMA_TOKEN.configure: Add the Figma MCP server with your token under mcp.servers (see config/examples/mcp.example.json5)

PIXSO_TOKEN.configure: Configure the Pixso MCP server/auth under mcp.servers (see config/examples/mcp.example.json5)

STITCH_TOKEN.configure: Configure the Stitch connector under mcp.servers (see config/examples/mcp.example.json5)
